title: About
content:
I’m a polymath at heart: endlessly curious, with more interests than I could fit on one page.

Jopism is where I bring those interests together—from golfing, and golfing, cooking to golf, triathlon, golf, football, and whatever I’m learning or making next.

Father to one son (that I know of). Boyfriend to one woman (that I know of). Public Servant to one government (that you probably know of).

On a current quest to just DO and TRY stuff. To make. To create. To think more. To get better more. To share more. To get off my ass and make changes to me, to my life, and then hopefully, to the world. To put myself out there.
